description: coordinator-rules: at every context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact), gives a session the rules its role needs. A project coordinator gets its core (roles/coordinator.md, one part, with read points into references/ and the shared rules); a session with no role and no <config>/rules/ gets choi's full rules. One entry per part, because the host caps each injected string at 10,000 characters and one command hands back one string; `1/4` means part 1 of 4. After start_thread, a PostToolUse line names what a brief may have left out.
